# Nusii proposals

Proposal software that both you and your clients will love. Stop fighting with Word, InDesign and PDF's. Create beautiful proposals in less time, every time with Nusii.

Category: Sales & CRM. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/nusii-proposals/.

## Actions

- **Create Client**: Create a new client in Nusii Proposals.
- **Create Line Item**: Create a line item within a proposal section.
- **Create Proposal**: Create a new proposal in Nusii.
- **Create Section**: Create a section for a proposal or template in Nusii Proposals.
- **Create Webhook Endpoint**: Create a webhook endpoint to subscribe to Nusii events.
- **Delete a client**: Delete a specific client from Nusii account.
- **Delete a proposal**: Delete a proposal from the system.
- **Delete a section**: Delete a specific section from Nusii.
- **Delete Line Item**: Delete a line item from Nusii.
- **Get Account Me** (read-only): Retrieve authenticated user's personal account information and settings.
- **Get Client** (read-only): Retrieve a single client from Nusii using their unique identifier.
- **Get Proposal** (read-only): Retrieve a single proposal with complete details and sections.
- **Get Section** (read-only): Retrieve a single section from a proposal or template in Nusii.
- **List Clients** (read-only): Retrieve all clients associated with the account.
- **List Line Items** (read-only): Retrieve all line items from Nusii Proposals with pagination support.
- **List Proposal Activities** (read-only): Retrieve all proposal activities with optional filtering by proposal or client ID.
- **List Proposals** (read-only): Retrieve all proposals from your Nusii account with pagination and filtering options.
- **List Sections** (read-only): Retrieve all sections with optional filtering for proposals or templates.
- **Update Client**: Update an existing client's information in Nusii.
- **Update Line Item**: Update an existing line item in Nusii proposals.
- **Update Proposal**: Update an existing proposal in Nusii.
- **Update Section**: Update an existing section in a proposal or template.
- **Archive Proposal**: Archive a specific proposal in Nusii.
- **Delete Webhook Endpoint**: Delete a specific webhook endpoint from the system.
- **Get Webhook Endpoint** (read-only): Retrieve a single webhook endpoint configuration.
- **List Section Line Items** (read-only): Retrieve all line items from a specific section.
- **List Themes** (read-only): Retrieve all available themes for proposals in Nusii.
- **List Users** (read-only): Retrieve all users in paginated format.
- **List Webhook Endpoints** (read-only): Retrieve all webhook endpoints configured for your Nusii account.
